Bash(git commit --no-gpg-sign -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for NuGet publishing

- Directory.Build.props with packing metadata and Source Link
- GitVersion.yml for semantic versioning \(ContinuousDelivery\)
- pipeline.yml: build, test \(unit + integration\), pack, publish
- IsPackable=false for Console and Test projects
- Publish job runs only on v* tags with --skip-duplicate

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh pr create --base develop --head feature/embeddings --title "Add embedding support and CI/CD pipeline" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Add embedding support for OpenAI and Cohere providers
- Add GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for NuGet publishing
- Configure Directory.Build.props, GitVersion, Source Link

## Test plan
- [ ] CI pipeline builds successfully
- [ ] Unit tests pass on both net8.0 and net10.0
- [ ] Integration tests run with secrets
- [ ] NuGet packages are packed correctly
EOF
\)")
